meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论转为对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue comments into conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 GitHub 机器人账号，在仓库的 PR 和 Issue 评论中回复 @提及。每条 PR 或 Issue 的评论串会成为一个独立的对话。
howto.when: 当有人在仓库的 PR 或 Issue 评论中 @机器人账号时触发。首次 @后，该线程会被订阅，后续所有评论都会自动回复。

say.text: 帮我回复这个 PR 的评论：@my-org-bot 请检查代码
在 Issue #5 中 @my-org-bot 分析一下这个 bug

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can reply to @mentions in PR and issue comments via a GitHub bot account. Each PR or issue comment thread becomes a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment. After the first mention, the thread is subscribed and all subsequent comments are auto-replied.

say_en.text: Reply to this PR comment: @my-org-bot please review the code
say_en.note: Bot will reply to that comment
